note: Printed claims only (Step 6). Wires are the printed 37 (image-read against PDF p.41; the list matches programs.json), no wire erratum. ER-39 (ERRATA sheet errata.pdf p.4, Book V 'page 35') is prose only: the p.35 procedure's 'Light 3 will flash on whenever...' becomes 'Light 6 will flash on whenever...', so errata_applied is empty and the search-mode lamp asserted is output light 6; the uncorrected 'light 3' claim is superseded and not asserted (output light 3 stays dark in search mode in this simulator and lights only in track mode, consistent with ER-39). Script: slide switch 6 RIGHT, power on (search mode); two light-6 flashes, each asserted as light 6 ON while the dial is on the object-signal contact c1 (printed M+/D1) and then OFF, and between them the dial reaches c9 (p.35 "constantly scans its environment"; c9 is a script choice of a contact far from the object signal, which a dial tracking c1 never reaches); still in search mode the object signal is moved (p.35 "You may move the object signal...") by removing cord 36 (M+/D1) and plugging cord 37 M+#1/D5#1, and light 6 is asserted ON with the dial on c5 and then OFF; slide switch 6 LEFT (track mode); oscillation about c5; the object signal moved again by removing cord 37 and plugging cord 38 M+#1/D9#1 (D5 and D9 are script choices; the footnote allows any dial point); until c9 (finds the new location); oscillation about c9. 'Oscillates about the object signal' is asserted as three times leaving the contact (until gap) and returning to it within 1000 ms; 1000 ms is a script choice below one revolution at the profile run rate (1333 ms at 45 rpm, longer at any slower rate) and well above the reversal round trip at 25 rpm, so a dial that merely keeps rotating fails it. How far the dial overshoots before reversing (to c4/c6 about c5 and to c8/c10 about c9 here), the reversal direction, the track-mode lamp and relay states, and the search direction after the move are not printed and are not asserted. The 3000 ms advances before each oscillation check are settling windows, not source timing. Trips the knife-edge trigger (minDecisionUa 0 below the profile minimum 14); the bless gate's robustness check held all six perturbations. Rotary run rate, coast and geometry are profile fallbacks O-R1, O-R3, O-R5.
